sources.title: Who is accountable when an AI agent proposes a test action but the ...
sources.snippet: If an AI agent proposes an unsafe test and the platform blocks it, the human operator is still accountable for what they asked the system to do. The platform owner is accountable for whether the block was technically sound and properly logged.
